subject.title: [Feature] Allow configuring Gemini safety settings in OpenClaw

question: Should OpenClaw expose configurable Gemini safety thresholds, and if so should the permanent contract use existing provider/model params or a new typed provider field, with what precedence and endpoint scope?
rationale: The change can relax provider safety filtering and creates a durable configuration contract; source inspection establishes the missing behavior but cannot choose that policy or compatibility boundary.

options.title: Use plugin-owned params
options.body: Approve a validated Google-plugin contract under existing provider/model parameter seams, preserving defaults and giving explicit request values precedence.

options.title: Limit direct Gemini scope
options.body: Support only model-scoped settings for the official direct Gemini API and exclude Vertex and custom Google-compatible endpoints until separately proven.

options.title: Decline configurable relaxation
options.body: Keep provider defaults authoritative and close the request as not planned because OpenClaw should not expose safety-threshold relaxation.

recommendation.title: Use plugin-owned params
recommendation.body: Approve a validated Google-plugin contract under existing provider/model parameter seams, preserving defaults and giving explicit request values precedence.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle explicitly routed the issue for product follow-up and has the strongest combined Google transport and provider-config history.
